# ces-revisions roadmap

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/ces-revisions-prompt.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-chatgpt.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-claude.md, specs/ces-revisions-research-gemini.md.
Choices made: Python 3.14, uv-managed package (`.python-version`, `uv.lock`).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | How the size of the one-month revision moves with the number of collection days before first release | A | 1 | A day or two to assemble the release calendar and monthly vintages; basis: public release dates and archived prints. Fit time on about 40 years of monthly vintages: measured by Stage 1 |
| O3 | How much of the one- and two-month revisions comes from late sample reports, and how much from seasonal-factor revision | A | 2 | Not estimated; reuses the vintages Stage 1 assembles. Fit time: measured by Stage 1 |
| O2 | How the size of the two-month revision moves with the first-closing collection rate | A | 3 | Not estimated; reuses the vintages Stage 1 assembles. Fit time: measured by Stage 1 |
| O6 | How revision size moves with CES sample size and sample attrition | B | 1 | Not estimated; series hand-built from archived releases. Measured by Stage 2 |
| O4 | How revision size moves with real BLS appropriations, continuing resolutions and shutdowns | B | 2 | Several days to hand-build; basis: budget justifications and archived releases |
| O5 | How revision size moves with BLS staffing counts | B | 3 | Several days to hand-build; basis: budget justifications and staffing reports |

Tracks (ranked A, then B):
A — Collection interval and revision size (research).
B — Budget, staffing and attrition (research). Split from A because A rests on sharp month-to-month calendar variation that public release dates give directly, while B's covariates move slowly, trend together and must be hand-built. Either answer stands without the other, and B's answer does not change A's model.

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Collection days and one-month revision size
      Objective: Measure how the scale of the one-month revision moves with collection days before first release, on real CES vintages.
      Outcomes: O1
      Track: A
      Consumes: nothing; the repository holds only the package scaffold and smoke tests.
      Produces: specs/ces-revisions-stage-1-findings.md; the release calendar with collection-day counts and the first-, second- and third-print vintage series, as named in this stage plan's Handoff.
      Exit: The findings file reports the estimated effect of collection days on one-month revision scale, with its uncertainty, from real first and second prints. It also records the measured wall-clock time to assemble the calendar and vintages and the time of the real model fit.
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Track A Ranked list, item Q-A1); supersector pooling (Q-A2); structural-change handling for 2003 and 2020–2022 (Q-A3); a vintage store with as-of queries and download manifests (Q-A4).
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Sample size, attrition and revision size
      Objective: Measure how revision scale moves with CES sample size and sample attrition, on real hand-built series.
      Outcomes: O6
      Track: B
      Consumes: the vintage series from Stage 1 (plan <id>, Handoff).
      Produces: specs/ces-revisions-stage-2-findings.md; the hand-built sample-size and attrition series, as named in this stage plan's Handoff.
      Exit: The findings file reports the estimated effect of sample size and attrition on revision scale, with its uncertainty, and states what the slow-moving series can and cannot identify. It also records the measured hours to hand-build the series and the time of the real model fit.
      Leaves out: full validation suite (Track B Ranked list, item Q-B1); supersector pooling (Q-B2); structural-change handling (Q-B3); source manifests for the hand-built series (Q-B4).
      ROUTING: brainstorming
